closure_self_reference_loop.description: The closure script embedded git rev-parse HEAD into the terminal report and governance, then amended that same commit — each amend changed HEAD, requiring another fill: an unbounded self-referential loop, plus repeated amend/push cycles.
closure_self_reference_loop.mechanism: tracked files recorded the SHA of the commit being amended; each amend invalidated the recorded SHA
closure_self_reference_loop.root_cause: self-referential git ancestry: a commit embedded a reference to its own future SHA (impossible to stabilize)
closure_self_reference_loop.resolution: Non-self-referential lineage model adopted (per FW00 precedent): the terminal report and governance record IMPLEMENTATION_COMMIT e972923 (the commit carrying implementation + proofs), written at report time and never embedded again. The final closure commit records e972923 as its parent and is itself verified only by git log at read time; its own SHA is deliberately NOT embedded in any tracked file.
closure_self_reference_loop.guard: fill script reads its target from .tmp/fw01_lineage_sha.txt, never from git rev-parse HEAD, and rejects any target equal to current HEAD (SELF_REFERENCE_GUARD, deterministic). Guard is protected by tests/test_p2p_fw01_closure_no_self_reference.py (4/4 PASS).
